attempts.summary: Configured node1 (Alpine Linux, extlinux/syslinux bootloader) to boot the kernel with audit=1 persistently by adding it to default_kernel_opts in /etc/update-extlinux.conf and regenerating /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux. Verified the setting survives a full reboot: node1 was safely restarted, its boot_id changed confirming an actual reboot, and /proc/cmdline on the new boot shows audit=1 present.
